name: ritmolux-studio
description: The Ritmolux studio: an Electron shell that edits a preset by driving the player.
author: Igor Konovalov

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "main,preload,vite,electron" -c "yellow,magenta,cyan,green" "node scripts/build-main.mjs --watch" "node scripts/build-preload.mjs --watch" "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5273 file:dist/main/index.cjs file:dist/preload/index.cjs && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5273 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.main.json && tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.preload.json && tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.test.json
